_: The tools the installer bundles, pinned to an exact release and sha256. stage-installer.mjs refuses a download that does not match. To update one: change the version in the url, then put the sha256 the publisher lists for it (ffmpeg: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ffmpeg-release-essentials.zip.sha256 for the current build; uv: the .sha256 file next to the zip on its GitHub release).
